name: fishing-hook
comment: WP-2.4. A stone block y 55..60 over x, z -8..8 with still water (id 9) at y 56..60 over x 0..8, z -4..4 (deep enough that the bobber does not reach the bottom: a block hit would leave it in the ground for good, EntityFish.java:228-230). A player (id 0) at (-1.5, 61, 0.5) facing +x and down (yaw -90, pitch 30) gets a fishing rod (346) through use_item on a workbench (BlockWorkbench.blockActivated is true, so the rod is not used), then the harness kind FishingHook makes EntityFish(world, player) (id 1, sets player.fishEntity; calculateVelocity's draws replayed on the seeded rand). The bobber flies, lands in the water and floats: the 5-slice water fraction, buoyancy, drag; each tick with no fish on it draws rand.nextInt(300) (open sky) for a bite, which sets ticksCatchable (rand), pulls it under and draws the splash and the particle offsets (EntityFish.java:272-303); while a fish is on, three more floats per tick. catchFish (the rod's next use, ItemFishingRod, WP-2.6) is not reached. rng_state and entity_state of the bobber every tick.
